content_sections.heading: TISS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS MEDICAL OFFICER position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the TISS MEDICAL OFFICER recruitment is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the MEDICAL OFFICER post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by MCI, be registered with MCI or a State Medical Council, and have at least three years of working experience in a hospital attached to a Medical College or a Corporate Hospital. Post Graduate Medical Sciences is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the MEDICAL OFFICER position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the MEDICAL OFFICER post is 55 years as of 30 June 2026. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the TISS MEDICAL OFFICER role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the MEDICAL OFFICER position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the TISS MEDICAL OFFICER recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted online through the official TISS website. The application link will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for different categories?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 125/- for SC/ST candidates. Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the MEDICAL OFFICER post involves a Personal Interaction followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contract position?
faq.answer: The TISS MEDICAL OFFICER position is a contract-based job as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies for the MEDICAL OFFICER post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the MEDICAL OFFICER post at the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS).
